Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Reorganize ownership around CanvasWorkspace, CanvasSession, MappingDocumentController, and the tldraw runtime. Place CanvasViews, workspace tools, source windows, projection, agent commands, and persistence under their callers.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Separate immutable content revisions and logical nodeRefs from per-placement presentation.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Retain ProjectedPane as display state, but show expanded source and code projections rendering in SourceWindowPanel outside the canvas.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Show issued revisions, controller batches, review and alternative operations, and browser command receipts; retain the live-versus-proposal boundary.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Add saved CanvasView checkpoints and referenced revisions as consumers of the existing history owner.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Replace sole-writer service ownership with explicit revision creation, retention, generation, and controller publication.
  |   `-- [2] Add: tldraw editor and runtime projection
  |       `-- Attach to MappingPage's CanvasSession renderer; show shapes and interactions projecting controller state without owning another semantic document.
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: CanvasSession
  |       `-- Add selection-bound prompt references and treemap tile selection to the adapters and consumers of SelectionState, not to panel lifetime.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize generation around pinned revisions and references, templates, create or extend operations, in-place or variant outcomes, and acknowledged installation; retain context isolation and retries.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Replace the edit-only request with operation, replacement scope, template, reference, panel-context, and placement inputs.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Include retained variants or created placements, agent-session identity, and context returned after acknowledgement.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Add rendered templates and pinned reference excerpts to the current task input.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |       `-- Distinguish installed content from retained review variants and newly placed diagrams.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the interface inventory around current reads and mutations, generation, CanvasViews, projection, and checkpoint publication while retaining supported routes.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Separate generation, browser commands and receipts, proposal editing, and durable publication at their service boundaries.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Identify worker-backed current-content search rather than treating the proposed persisted SearchArtifact as implemented.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Add checkpoint publication and CanvasView and projection persistence callers; workspace autosave still does not publish a catalog revision.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [D] Baseline/proposed -> unified review
  |       `-- Add captured diff-tree mappings and the read-only change-treemap consumer; hunk allocation does not establish live node identity.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Include CanvasView and projection checkpoints, retained source-pane state, and flush-before-publication callers without merging autosave and catalog publication.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
  |       `-- Attach tldraw swap controls and SidePanel rendering to per-placement choices; projected rows change without rebinding content.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |       `-- Locate CanvasViewControls, CanvasViewReceiver, controller checkpoints, and workspace persistence within the existing save, switch, fork, keep, and discard lifecycle.
  |-- Roll-up 1 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage, [D] Controller edits / agent access, and [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Mirror the corrected ownership boundaries of their domain-model counterparts; retain accurate revision, alternative, and review material.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram and [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Mirror the content-versus-presentation and external source-window corrections.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Add saved-view checkpoint consumers without duplicating the detailed lifecycle.
  |-- Roll-up 2 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage, [D] Controller edits / agent access, and [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Mirror corrected workspace, edit, and revision ownership while preserving accurate placement-choice summaries.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram and [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Mirror the content-versus-presentation and external source-window corrections.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Add saved-view checkpoint consumers without repeating the detailed lifecycle.
  |-- [3] Prompt composition and generation  new canvas
  |   |-- PromptComposer ownership
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's workspace-tools component; show coordinator-owned drafts, templates, pinned references, and its DiagramEditService caller path.
  |   |-- Generation and acknowledgement
  |   |   `-- Follow generation or supplied content through browser installation, persistence, polling, and safe retry.
  |   `-- Variant review interaction
  |       `-- Connect to [P2] Review versus presentation; review decisions and optional presentation selection remain separate.
  |-- [3] Source windows and navigation  new canvas
  |   |-- SourceWindowPanel ownership
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's ProjectedPane and SourcePaneViewState components; expanded projection state chooses the external window.
  |   `-- SourceCodePane navigation
  |       `-- Show repository reads and reload, stale-range handling, compactions, definitions, file history, and retained scroll state.
  |-- [3] Search and canvas navigation  new canvas
  |   |-- DiagramSearchService and worker index
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's workspace-tools component; index current diagram content and placements, not source evidence or persisted search artifacts.
  |   `-- Search result reveal
  |       `-- Validate the result's content revision before focusing a live or proposal canvas and revealing folded matches.
  |-- [3] Treemap projections  new canvas
  |   |-- Canvas source treemap
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's workspace-tools component; allocate verified mapped source lines among diagram nodes and exclude unresolved ranges.
  |   |-- Change treemap
  |   |   `-- Connect from ChangeSession's diff-tree mappings; allocate captured hunk LOC among resolved destinations and retain Unmapped hunks.
  |   `-- Treemap rendering and navigation
  |       `-- Show area-preserving tiles, read-only canvas tints, tile selection, and navigation for both projections.
  `-- [3] Focused canvas projection  new canvas
      |-- Projection creation
      |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's CanvasWorkspace component; copy selected or highlighted placements into an independent child with a blank placeholder.
      |-- Layout ownership
      |   `-- Show pinned source geometry, worker-calculated positions, and controller-committed layout checkpoints.
      `-- Projection navigation and persistence
          `-- Show child-only undo and redo and child persistence while the source and unrelated sessions remain in place.
